instruction.text: Lies den Bericht und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.text: Yesterday, James celebrated his birthday at home. He invited all of his friends. They played games and ate a delicious chocolate cake. There was still a piece of cake left at 6pm. James' friends, Kenan and Lily, both wanted to eat the last piece of the delicious chocolate cake. Kenan quickly took the last piece of it and ate it. Lily then shouted at him loudly and pushed him angrily. Afterwards, Kenan fell on the floor, hurt his arm and cried terribly.

instruction.text: Was hätten Kenan und Lily tun können, um den Streit zu vermeiden?
